titulo.estudio: Un article qui propose des solutions : Lire l'ensemble
titulo.alumno: An article with proposals: Integrated reading

intro: Connect a social problem with its causes, proposals and possible limits. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Connect a social problem with its causes, proposals and possible limits. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: causal and concessive connectors organise an argument; the conditional can present cautious proposals. In this passage, «déchets» means «waste».

piezas.titulo: Un article qui propose des solutions

frases.estudio: Dans plusieurs quartiers, les habitants produisent davantage de déchets depuis que les livraisons à domicile se sont développées.
frases.alumno: In several neighbourhoods, residents produce more waste since home deliveries became common.

frases.estudio: Une association propose des points de collecte où l'on peut déposer les emballages réutilisables.
frases.alumno: An association proposes collection points where reusable packaging can be left.

frases.estudio: La mesure réduirait le plastique, à condition que les commerces acceptent de participer.
frases.alumno: The measure would reduce plastic, provided that shops agreed to take part.

frases.estudio: Cependant, la mairie doit préciser qui nettoiera les points et comment les coûts seront partagés.
frases.alumno: However, the town council must specify who will clean the points and how the costs will be shared.
